parameters.name: pathId
parameters.description: The process path's identity (e.g. "pack", "pick", "stow"). By convention, the Certification required to be assigned to a path has the same name as the PathId.

parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1): plan lookup key AND associate scope. Required unless the deprecated buildingId is given. Accepted as given, never validated against facility-layout, so an unknown code simply counts 0.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: DEPRECATED -- use siteCode. The legacy name of the plan key: alias for the plan lookup ONLY (same stored value). A call that gives only buildingId is not scoped by site. Required unless siteCode is given.

parameters.name: shiftId
parameters.description: The shift (within the site) whose committed plan to read.
